channel.title: VICEWIRE | GTA VI news, PC and emulation
channel.description: Source-linked GTA VI news and developer activity with evidence labels.

item.title: Leonida's recompilation project: shaders translated, GTA VI still does not boot
item.description: The developers report translating 26,503 Xbox RDNA2 shaders. Their README explicitly states the game does not boot yet. A shader milestone is not a playable PC port. Why it matters: The key milestone is booting actual GTA VI code, not just translating shaders. A developer repository can be active long before the game runs.

item.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album is now available
item.description: Rockstar announced the official GTA VI soundtrack album, released alongside the console launch week. Why it matters: This is an official game release-week update, but it doesn't announce anything about the PC port.

item.title: Bitdefender investigates fake GTA VI PC streaming client distributing malware
item.description: Security researchers documented a fake PC streaming client that uses a ClickFix-style attack. Do not treat PC client installers as evidence of an unofficial port. Why it matters: There is no verified PC client to install. Third-party installers should not be confused with a playable game.

item.title: Cyberleek claims a GTA VI Xbox build leaked without its executable
item.description: VGC reported that Cyberleek claimed to distribute a November 2026 Xbox development build, with the main executable withheld. Screenshots and the group's own statements do not independently establish that the archive is genuine. Why it matters: Without the executable, nobody can demonstrate that the alleged files boot. Even an authentic Xbox executable would still require major translation or emulation work on PC.

item.title: Cyberleek ties a promised missing GTA VI executable to a crypto target
item.description: According to PC Gamer, Cyberleek claimed the missing Xbox executable would come on November 23 regardless, or earlier if a crypto token reached a $15 million market value. The outlet said the alleged build had not been authenticated. Why it matters: This is a future promise, not evidence of a file or a working port. The cryptocurrency condition is an additional reason to treat links and related claims cautiously.

item.title: GTA VI officially launches on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S
item.description: Take-Two confirms that Grand Theft Auto VI is available on current-generation PlayStation and Xbox consoles. No PC launch was part of this release announcement. Why it matters: The console launch is confirmed. PC is a separate milestone, not an implied part of this launch.

item.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Now Available: Rockstar's launch announcement
item.description: Rockstar's official launch post introduces GTA VI's release-day features and the state of Leonida. Why it matters: The best way to confirm Rockstar announcements is to read the publisher's original post.

item.title: No verified GTA VI gameplay through PS5 emulation or an unofficial PC port
item.description: A November 18 assessment says current PS5 emulation does not provide a playable GTA VI PC experience. This is independent reporting, not an official Rockstar statement. Why it matters: Emulating basic PS5 software or homebrew is different from running a complex commercial title like GTA VI.

item.title: Netcraft exposes fake GTA VI cracked builds and misleading PC download sites
item.description: Netcraft analyzed phishing and malware lures presented as leaked builds, cracks or PC releases. Evidence of a fake installer is not evidence of a working port. Why it matters: A downloadable file marketed as a crack can be a malware lure. This is a security update, not proof a working crack exists.

item.title: Rockstar releases the Grand Theft Auto VI launch trailer
item.description: The official launch trailer is available from Rockstar, with footage and the original soundtrack score. Why it matters: This is first-party marketing material, useful for official visuals but unrelated to PC availability.
